🏥 MediFlow Smart Healthcare System
A complete digital platform for hospitals — appointments, prescriptions, lab tests, billing, surgery scheduling and RFID-based patient identification, all in one place.
📋 Digital Prescriptions 💳 Health Card & Payments 🧪 Lab Test Tracking 🔪 Surgery Management
📲 Download Android App (APK)
Android: direct install — your phone may ask you to allow "install from unknown sources" the first time.
🍏 Add MediFlow to your Home Screen
1️⃣ Open this page in Safari (not Chrome — iOS only allows this from Safari)
2️⃣ Tap the Share icon ⬆️ in the toolbar
3️⃣ Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
4️⃣ Tap Add — MediFlow now opens full-screen like a normal app
iOS doesn't allow installing apps outside the App Store, so this Home Screen install is the equivalent of the Android APK — same app, no App Store needed.
